widgets_values: Details and style for your subject
Step count in generative diffusion simply means and defines the allocated time the diffusion model is allowed to explore new ideas and iterate details.

Sammplers in generative diffusion are different methods that have different interpretations of your prompt which to the brain (Diffusion Model) is just noise, each sampler has it's own unique way of "denoising" it which is why you may see slightly different results per sampler.

CFG (Classifier Free Guidance), to put it simply is how much bias your prompt's have in guiding the brain (Diffusion Model) to what you would like to see, or not (negative).


Key Note (optional): CFG that is too high for the diffusion model Architecture you have will most likely restrict its freedom of searching for alternative solutions that are not exactly your prompt.

The vision of your world means adding extra details to your subject, defining your vision of the composition more, which you can also bias the camera's angles and perspective in which you would like your world to encompass.
